name: beam-agents fraud triage
description: Runs the beam-agents fraud-triage agent as a streaming Dataflow job: keyed transaction events in, a human-approval suspension flow through the intents outbox, and terminal freeze/release decisions out. Provider API keys are supplied by Secret Manager resource name and are never launch parameters.

parameters.name: input_topic
parameters.label: Transaction events topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic carrying AgentEnvelope-encoded transaction events, in the sink resolver's URI grammar: pubsub://<project>/<topic>.

parameters.name: approvals_topic
parameters.label: Approvals topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic the effector publishes human decisions back onto, keyed by the same entity key the suspension committed under. Format: pubsub://<project>/<topic>.

parameters.name: output_topic
parameters.label: Decisions topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic terminal triage decisions are written to (freeze/release/cleared, and the fail-closed timeout output). Format: pubsub://<project>/<topic>.

parameters.name: intents_topic
parameters.label: Intents outbox topic
parameters.helpText: Pub/Sub topic the approval intents are written to for the effector to consume. Becomes AgentConfig.intents_to, so the keyed outbox writer handles ordering and dead-lettering. Format: pubsub://<project>/<topic>.

parameters.name: model
parameters.label: Provider reference
parameters.helpText: The LLM provider, named in the YAML provider's module:object grammar (docs/yaml.md) — for example beam_agents.model.anthropic:AnthropicProvider, or examples.fraud_triage:make_provider for the scripted FakeLLM used by validation runs. A provider that requires an API key also requires model_api_key_secret.

parameters.name: hitl_timeout_ms
parameters.label: Human approval deadline (ms)
parameters.helpText: How long an activation waits for a human decision before failing closed. Maps to HitlPolicy.timeout_ms and to the deadline the suspension itself carries. Defaults to the runtime default (86400000 ms) when omitted.

parameters.name: errors_to
parameters.label: Errors sink URI
parameters.helpText: Optional sink for the errors stream, in the sink resolver's grammar: kafka://<servers>/<topic>, pubsub://<project>/<topic>, or bigquery://<project>/<dataset>/<table>. Unset leaves the stream unconsumed.

parameters.name: traces_to
parameters.label: Traces sink URI
parameters.helpText: Optional sink for the traces stream. Same grammar as errors_to, plus otlp://<host>[:<port>] for an OTLP/HTTP collector. Unset leaves the stream unconsumed.

parameters.name: model_api_key_secret
parameters.label: Provider API key secret version
parameters.helpText: Secret Manager resource name of the version holding the provider's API key: projects/<project>/secrets/<secret>/versions/<version>. The value is read on the worker at provider construction using the job service account's credentials; it never appears in launch parameters, job metadata, or logs. Required when model names a provider that takes an api_key; omit it for the FakeLLM path.
